items.t: What Itau Unibanco (ITUB) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call

items.t: Deutsche Bank Launched Crypto Custody With Bitcoin and Ethereum but Not XRP or Solana. Why Were They Left Out?
items.sum: Germany's largest bank just opened its vault to institutional clients, and two of crypto's biggest names never got a key. The real reason may lie in who is on the guest list, and who owns one of the five spots.

items.t: Itaú Selects Harness to Advance AI-Era Software Delivery Across Latin America's Largest Private Bank
items.sum: Harness, the Autonomous SDLC Platform™, today announced Itaú Unibanco, the largest private-sector bank in Latin America, will use Harness as part of its strategy to evolve the foundations of software delivery across its entire engineering organization.

items.t: What Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores (AVAL) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
items.sum: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores (NYSE:AVAL) reported a 29% decline in third-quarter attributable net income as weaker investment margins and costs associated with incorporating Itaú’s retail banking business weighed on results. Net income was COP 368 billion, with a return on average equity of 7.9%,

items.t: Itaúsa reports record recurring net income of R$5.1 billion in 3Q26, up 25%
items.sum: Itaúsa (B3: ITSA4), Brazil's largest publicly traded investment holding company, reported record recurring net income of R$5.1 billion in the third quarter of 2026, up 25% compared to 3Q25, and recurring ROE of 21.1%, an increase of 3.3 percentage points. In the first nine months of the year, recurring net income totaled R$13.9 billion, up 16%.
